notes: Tracing is non-mastery motor practice and does not claim handwriting correctness.
Paid eligibility must remain false until external release gates are recorded.
Letter discovery uses short one-shot motion with a static reduced-motion fallback.
Multiple picture words per letter are authored content; deterministic review may select among them.
Nursery domain visuals use semantic visualKey values; raw emoji are not authored content.
Visual-heavy activities store semantic payload.visualTokens separately from child-facing prompt text.
Canonical option IDs and correctness rules use semantic values; legacy pictograms are accepted only by the compatibility adapter.
Each A-Z letter keeps at least eight authored discovery examples in the current v1 pack.
The v1 Nursery pack must contain at least 200 unique local picture-card assets in total.
Picture-card assets are bundled locally; picture text is a semantic lowercase fallback, never an emoji.
Beginning-sound generators only use examples explicitly marked eligible.
Discovery browsing is teaching-only and never contributes mastery evidence.
soundPracticeEligible and beginningSoundEligible are evidence gates, not automatic consequences of spelling.
Irregular vowels, advanced Q/X patterns, SH, and initial consonant clusters may remain discovery cards while being excluded from simple Nursery phonics mastery.
